@SajayR Thanks for the amazing write-up. We had an impressive batch of submissions, and after a lot of consideration, we decided to award the prize to Aaron's submission: https://aaronleslie.dev/blog/comma-compression

That said, we’d still love to link your write-up in the README if you’re okay with that.
@YassineYousfi  I'd love to have it linked, and I agree Aaron deserves the prize--I enjoyed reading his write-up so much and the approach he engineered.

@SajayR Congratulations on making it onto the leaderboard! I hope you had fun competing in the challenge and learned something new along the way. If you are looking for a job or internship, please email givemeajob@comma.ai with a link to this PR. See you in the next challenge!
